regions.merged_text: God bless you all-you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of a few weeks back. I hope you enjoyed your vacation-you and your Father. I started to fix up a big card-certificate for the Poor Souls to sent your Mother but was not certain about her first name, so let it go. I am not sure if I sent your Brother-in-law certificates. Its taken me so far pretty much to get acquainted with the work, etc here. Today five of us go up to the Immaculate Conception Monastery across from West Point, to make our annual retreat. In other words we'll try a- gain to be converted for another year.
